in_marathi.name: Nannu
in_marathi.long_meaning: Nannu हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘nna’, meaning ‘gift’ or ‘blessing’. In Hindu mythology, Lord Shiva is also known as Nannadesa or Nannadri, symbolizing the giver of blessings and boons.

in_bengali.name: Nannu
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Gift, Blessing
in_bengali.long_meaning: Nannu একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘nna’, meaning ‘gift’ or ‘blessing’. In Hindu mythology, Lord Shiva is also known as Nannadesa or Nannadri, symbolizing the giver of blessings and boons.
